title: "Data Visualization"
subtitle: "Grammar of graphics with ggplot2: histograms, scatterplots, and themes."
---

::: {.callout-note title="Where you are in your learning journey" icon=false}
**Where you come from.** You arrive here from [Grouping and summarizing](grouping-and-summarizing.qmd). You can summarise data per group.

**What this module adds.** You'll make graphs with `ggplot2`: histograms, bar charts, boxplots, and scatterplots, and style them with themes and labels.

**Why it is valuable.** Plots reveal patterns, outliers, and mistakes that summary numbers hide, and they are the best way to communicate results.

**Where it leads.** Next up: [Advanced Visualization](advanced-visualization.qmd).
:::
